Swamp Slime
By: Amy Jeanroy
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 11:46pm

Ingredients




1 Box Green Jello
1 Pkg  Gummy bugs

Preparation

1 Make green jello. Remove 1/2 cup and set aside.  2 Chill remaining jello. When it starts to solidify, add various gummy bugs.Stir gently to combine. 3 Beat the rest of the jello to a froth and add to the top of the gummy bug filled jello. Chill once again until firm.
